source.title: Pyoderma Gangrenosum: An Updated Literature Review on Established and Emerging Pharmacological Treatments
source.whyItFits: Open review of pyoderma gangrenosum diagnosis frameworks and first-line systemic treatment, including the STOP GAP comparison of prednisolone and cyclosporine.
